QuestInfo.name: Colette the Intelligence Collector
QuestInfo.0: #p1401001# has some good theories, but it's time to let her work. Get over to #b#p1401002##k to see what she's procured.
QuestInfo.1: #p1401002# paid off an intelligence broker named #p1002104#. Head down to #m104000000# on #bVictoria Island#k to collect.
QuestInfo.2: You met Information Dealer #p1002104# in #m104000000#, but you're not sure you can trust him just yet.

0.0: Hi, captain! I heard you went all the way down to #m310000000# by yourself! You're the craziest rich guy I know! You can hire people to do that stuff.\r\n#L0##bCheerful as ever, aren't we, #p1401002#? I'm afraid we won't find any more information down there. The Black Wings have a tight hold on the place.#l\n#k
0.1: That's too bad! But I've got a new guy that could probably help us out! Isn't that just the greatest? His name is #p1002104##k and he lives in #b#m104000000#. \r\n#L0##b#p1002104#? Is it the Seal Stone again? I told him it wasn't that important.#l\n#k
0.2: This time, it seems to be about the Black Wings. I'm sure it's reliable, if you want me to go pay him off! \r\n#L0##bNo, you stay here and look for more intel sources, #p1401002#. I'm in the mood to get a move on. Plus, if I stick around, #p1401000# will be breathing down my neck in no time.#l\n#k
0.3: You're such a tough cookie, captain! #p1002104# is pretty good friends with your pal #p1404002#. You oughtta go tell Renault to turn the ship toward Victoria Island so we can get their right away!

yes.0: #m150000000# is the best! I'll take it off your hands if you ever want to sell her, captain!\r\n#e#r(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n

no.0: I thought you were in a big hurry!

1.0: Long time no see, Phantom. Last time we were looking for that Seal Stone, weren't we? I never would've guessed you were one of the legendary heroes.\r\n#L0##bI see word still travels faster than light in Maple World. This is going to make my life a lot more difficult.#l\n#k
1.2: If it weren't for you, that Seal Stone would be gone. You're so heroic! Not quite like #p1404002#, but still heroic!

yes.0: I'll give you whatever you need, hero of the age! Consider it a freebie for just the coolest person I've ever met!

npc.0: Not ready to go to #b#m104000000##k yet? #b#p1002104##k is waiting!

1.1: I can't believe I'm standing here talking to a real life hero! One of the greats! The cherry on a sundae!\r\n#L0##bOh, we're doing the whole 'hero worship' thing, are we? Fantastic. Look, I'm a thief first. That little scuffle with the Black Mage was ages ago.#l\n#k
